title: A King Wanted Him. He Asked for the Grain Stores

meta.name: v5_y12_11_the-storehouses
meta.title: A King Wanted Him. He Asked for the Grain Stores

lines.text: A king wanted him. He asked for the grain stores.
The king says he is trusted now.
Appoint me over the storehouses of the land. Indeed, I will be a knowing guardian.

quran.ar: ٱجۡعَلۡنِی عَلَىٰ خَزَاۤىِٕنِ ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ إِنِّی حَفِیظٌ عَلِیمࣱ

lines.text: We touch with Our mercy whom We will, and We do not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.

quran.ar: نُصِیبُ بِرَحۡمَتِنَا مَن نَّشَاۤءُۖ وَلَا نُضِیعُ أَجۡرَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِینَ

lines.text: He asked for a duty, not a crown.
He named his strengths: guard and know.
